migrate.heading: Import your mail
migrate.subheading: Bring your existing mailbox into Owlat — and let your AI assistant learn from it.
migrate.featureOffBody: Importing from another mailbox needs the external-accounts feature. Ask your Owlat admin to enable it, then come back here to bring your mail in.
migrate.providerPickTitle: Where does your mail live now?
migrate.readyBody: We'll import your entire mail history — Inbox, Sent, and all your archived mail.
migrate.readyBulletImport: Your old messages are imported into your Owlat inbox.
migrate.readyBulletAiOn: Your AI assistant learns from each conversation, scoped per contact.
migrate.readyBulletAiOff: Enable the AI knowledge feature first to let the assistant learn from your mail.
migrate.reconnectBody: Your mailbox credentials aren't working. Update your password below before importing — otherwise the import can't connect.
migrate.importingBody: You can leave this page — the import keeps running in the background.
migrate.indexingBody: Reading through your imported mail to learn about your contacts and conversations.
migrate.indexingFootnote: Your mail is already in your inbox — this last step just makes the AI smarter.
migrate.completedBody: Your mail history is in Owlat.
migrate.completedBodyWithAi: Your mail history is in Owlat and your AI assistant has learned from it.
migrate.signatureFoundBody: Spotted this at the end of your sent mail. Save it and Owlat will add it to your replies, just like before.
migrate.signatureSaved: Signature saved — it'll be added to your replies.
migrate.signatureTip: Tip: check your {link} so your replies look just like they did before.
migrate.failedFallbackError: Something went wrong while importing your mail.
migrate.failedBody: Any mail imported so far was kept. You can try again.
migrate.cancelledBody: The mail imported before you cancelled is still in your inbox.
migrate.cancelDialogDescription: Mail imported so far is kept. The rest of your history won't be imported unless you start again.
migrate.disconnectDialogDescription: Syncing stops and it's hidden from your inbox. Synced messages are kept unless you delete them separately.
migrate.purgeDialogTitle: Delete mailbox and all synced data?
migrate.purgeDialogDescription: Every imported message, draft, folder and label is erased and cannot be recovered. Use this if you connected the wrong mailbox or want your imported mail genuinely removed.
migrate.toastPurging: Mailbox and all synced data are being deleted.
migrate.toastCancelled: Migration cancelled. Imported mail was kept.

replyQueue.noMailboxHint: Provision your first personal mailbox to start receiving mail.

search.noResultsHint: Try fewer or broader terms, or operators like from:, has:attachment, is:unread.

index.loadErrorMessage: We hit an error loading your mailbox. Reload the page to try again.

detail.heading: Label view
detail.loadError: Couldn't load messages for this label. Reload to try again.

account.heading: Account Management
account.subheading: Manage your profile, password, data, and account
account.profileDescription: Your display name, used as the sender identity.
account.loginEmailVerifiedDescription: Change the email address you use to sign in. We send an approval link to your current address; once you follow it we send a final confirmation link to the new address. Your login email only changes after that last link is followed.
account.loginEmailUnverifiedDescription: Change the email address you use to sign in. We send a confirmation link to the new address — your login email only changes once you follow it.
account.confirmationSentApprove: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Follow it to approve changing your login email.
account.confirmationSentFinish: We sent a confirmation link to {email}. Follow it to finish changing your login email.
account.emailUnchanged: That is already your login email
account.emailChangeRequested: Check your inbox to confirm the change
account.changePasswordDescription: Update your password without signing out.
account.passwordTooShort: New password must be at least 10 characters
account.deletionPendingSubtitle: Your account is scheduled for deletion
account.deletionPendingBody: Your account and all associated data will be permanently deleted after the grace period. You can cancel this deletion at any time before the scheduled date.
account.exportSubtitle: Download a copy of all your data in JSON or CSV format
account.exportBody: You can export your data at any time. The export includes your profile information, your personal mailbox and mail, drafts, connected external accounts, your chat messages, and your team memberships. For teams where you are an owner or admin, it also includes contacts, campaigns, automations, and other associated data.
account.exportJsonDescription: JSON format with all your data: your mailbox, mail, drafts, chat, connected accounts, and memberships, plus team data where you are an owner or admin.
account.exportCsvDescription: CSV format for easy import into spreadsheets or other email tools.
account.deleteAccountSubtitle: Permanently delete your account and all associated data
account.deleteAccountBody: Deleting your account will permanently remove all your data after a 30-day grace period. During this period, you can cancel the deletion at any time.

deletedItems.ownedTeams: All teams you own and their data
deletedItems.personalMailbox: Your personal mailbox, mail, and drafts
deletedItems.externalAccounts: Connected external email accounts and app passwords
deletedItems.chatMemberships: Your chat messages and team memberships

account.memberDataNote: Data owned by your teams — contacts, campaigns, API keys, webhooks, and analytics — belongs to the team and is not removed by deleting your account.
account.deleteModalSubtitle: This action has a 30-day grace period
account.deleteModalWarning: {warning} After the 30-day grace period, your account and all associated data will be permanently deleted. This action cannot be undone.
account.reasonPlaceholder: Help us improve by sharing why you're leaving...
account.deletionRequested: Account deletion request submitted. Check your email for confirmation.

addAccount.heading: Add mail account
addAccount.teamDescription: A shared address your teammates can read and send from together — like {support} or {sales}. You'll be its owner.
addAccount.externalTeamDescription: Connect an existing mailbox (like {example}) as a shared inbox your teammates read and send from together. You'll be its owner, and your team reads it through the same connection.
addAccount.needVerifiedDomain: You need at least one verified domain before creating a hosted mailbox.
addAccount.noDomainHint: No domain to verify? Connect your existing email account instead.
addAccount.errorNoAddress: Please choose an address for the mailbox.
addAccount.errorNotSignedIn: Please make sure you are signed in.
addAccount.successTeamBody: Your team inbox is ready. Members can open it from their Postbox.
addAccount.successExternalNote: New mail sent to this address will start appearing here shortly. Mail already in the account isn't imported — only messages that arrive from now on.
addAccount.successHostedNote: Make sure your domain sends incoming mail to this Owlat instance so messages start flowing.

aliases.heading: Aliases
aliases.removeDialogDescription: Mail sent to this alias will start bouncing.

appPasswords.heading: App passwords
appPasswords.subheading: Generate per-device credentials for native mail clients (Apple Mail, Thunderbird, Gmail mobile, …).
appPasswords.passwordHint: Use an app password generated below — your dashboard password won't work here.
appPasswords.empty: No app passwords yet. Click "Generate" to create one.
appPasswords.revokeDialogDescription: Connected mail clients using this password will be signed out on next reconnect.
